about_the_game:
This unlocks the vintage cards that can be used in the game.

The product can now be purchased in the in-game shop, and cards can be obtained by crafting them from the card list.

The following cards and select PR cards can now be used.

・VG-TD05 "Slash of Silver Wolf"

・VG-TD06 "Resonance of Thunder Dragon"

・VG-BT06 "Breaker of Limits"

・VG-EB03 "Cavalry of Black Steel"

・VG-BT07 "Rampage of the Beast King"

You can obtain additional cards by purchasing packs from the in-game shop or by crafting them.

※Some PR cards from "PR Card Pack:Vintage Vol.2" are also included in this pack.

For card details, please check the latest updates on the official Cardfight!! Vanguard Dear Days 2 website.
